name: Kettlebell Rack Carry
steps: Clean two kettlebells cleanly into the front rack position with fists near your collarbone and forearms vertical.
Brace your abs firmly, keep your elbows tucked close to your ribs, and stack your rib cage over your pelvis.
Walk forward with smooth, deliberate strides while keeping your torso tall and breathing steadily behind your braced core.
Stop smoothly after covering the target distance and lower both kettlebells safely back to the floor.
tips: Avoid leaning backward under the front load by keeping your ribs tucked down and glutes active.
Keep your wrists straight and elbows tucked close rather than letting the bells pull your shoulders forward.
